name: backlog-syntax
description: Skills to let a coding agent use Backlog Syntax as its task backlog, over the remote MCP server or the REST API.

plugins.name: backlog-cloud
plugins.description: Teaches an agent to record, find and update tasks in the hosted Backlog Syntax at backlog.syntaxlab.com.br, with workspace selection, duplicate checks, leases and optimistic concurrency. Connect the MCP server or a service-account token separately.
